minutes_text:
MINUTES

  SPECIAL CITY COUNCIL MEETING

  SEPTEMBER 12, 2017

A special meeting of the City Council of Rolling Hills Estates was called to order at
4:10 p.m. in the City Manager’s Office, 4045 Palos Verdes Drive North, by
COUNCILMEMBER ZUCKERMAN.

City Council Members Present:  Huff*, Mitchell, Schmitz, Zuckerman and
  Mayor Zerunyan**
  *Councilmember Huff arrived at 5:15 p.m.
  **Mayor Zerunyan arrived at 4:30 p.m.

City Staff Present:  City Manager Doug Prichard
  Planning Director David Wahba

3.  GENERAL PLAN ADVISORY COMMITTEE INTERVIEWS

  The City Council conducted interviews for appointments to the General Plan
  Advisory Committee with additional interviews scheduled for Tuesday, September
  19, 2017. No action was taken.

4.  ADJOURNMENT

  At 5:45 p.m., MAYOR ZERUNYAN formally adjourned the City Council meeting to
  the regular meeting of September 12, 2017.

Submitted by,  Approved by,

Heidi Luce  Douglas R. Prichard
City Clerk  City Manager
